description: This file declares interfaces and classes related to cryptographic cipher implementations, including encryption and decryption methods, for a software project. It defines abstract and concrete classes for handling cipher operations, including support for different vault types.

classes.name: CipherImplementation
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for cipher operations such as Encrypt and Decrypt.

classes.name: Cipher
classes.description: Concrete implementation of CipherImplementation, supporting encryption/decryption with specified vault and algorithm.

classes.name: CipherNetflix
classes.description: Implementation of CipherImplementation tailored for Netflix vault integration.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Performs encryption of input data using specified IV and output buffer.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption of input data using specified IV and output buffer.

methods.name: Operation
methods.description: Performs either encryption or decryption based on the 'encrypt' flag.

methods.name: AESCipher
methods.description: Returns the AES cipher mode for the given mode parameter.
